source: One real run of invoice_processing.supporting_docs.extract (default call: general_invoice_agent.call_gemini_with_pdf, Pro model gemini-2.5-pro on Vertex, project rasayan) on 2026-10-09 over 26 PDFs; PDFs not committed. 20 GRNs from benchmark/dataset/generator/gen_render.render_grn over ACTIVE goods-vendor rows of benchmark/dataset/po_master.csv, built by a scratch script with random.Random(4208): difficulty cycles clean / degraded (degrade(path, 'MEDIUM')) / adversarial (degrade(path, 'MEDIUM', adversarial=True): RECEIVED stamp with a distractor date, watermark, handwritten note); every adversarial GRN is multi-line (up to 3 distinct items of one vendor, each from its own po_master row, under the first row's PO number; truth po_lines is that synthetic multi-line PO); 7 of 28 lines received short (x0.5/0.8/0.9 of ordered); GRN-06 receives PO lines 1 and 3 only, printed as GRN #1 and #2. GRN dates 2026-05..08, numbers GRN/26-27/NNNNN, receiver from gen_core.NAMES. Fonts: matplotlib's DejaVu TTFs via DEJAVU_FONTDIR (Condensed aliased to regular). Plus the dataset's 6 PURCHASE_ORDER non-documents copied as-is (TECH-INV-084/090 are image-only scans, the other 4 have a text layer); their truth is the po_master.csv row named by the submission's po_number, or for TECH-INV-091/SVC-INV-089 the PO number printed on the page.
